μάλη.definition: arm-pit, almost confined to the phrase

μάλθων.definition: weakling, opp. Socr. ap. Stob.4.15.16; = Lat. nebulo, Gloss

μαμιρά.definition: a medicinal root, Aët.12.64 , Alex.Trall.2, Paul. Aeg.7.3

μάνης.definition: a kind of cup, acc. sg; small bronze figure used in the game of , Hermipp.47, Antiph.55.11, Nicoch.10

μανότης.definition: opp. looseness of texture; rarity, separateness, Pl.Lg.812d; Thphr.CP3.7.1

μάντις.definition: gen. Ion. voc. pl., gen; Adj., of this prophetic band, dub. in S.Fr.113

μαρῖνος.definition: kind of sea-fish, dub. in Arist.HA570a32; v.l. for ib.602a1

μᾶρον.definition: a kind of sage, Teucrium Marum, Mnesim.4.61 , Thphr.Od.33, Dsc.3.42

μαρτύριον.definition: testimony, proof; the tables of the Decalogue, LXXLe.16.13, al

μάρτυς.definition: Cret., Epid. Leg.Gort.1.13, al; martyr, Apoc.2.13, etc

μάσδασνος.definition: = Avest. mazdayasna, worshipper of Mazda, title of kings of the Sassanid dynasty, OGI432.1

μαστίον.definition: cup in the form of a breast, IG7.3498.15, al

ματία.definition: Ion. vain attempt, bootless; folly, error, A.R.1.805, 4.367

μέγαρον.definition: gen. pl. Sophr.6; large room, hall; esp

μέδος.definition: mead, Goth. word in Prisc.p.300 D

μείλιγμα.definition: that which soothes; darling, fondling, of Agamemnon, A.Ag.1439

μείς.definition: crescent moon, Thphr.l.c. ; the part of the month corresponding to a phase of the moon, ibid. ; the visible part of the moon, Chrysipp. l. c

μέλανσις.definition: a becoming black, opp; dyeing black, Alex. Trall.1.3

μέλι.definition: gen. etc.; dat. Philox.3.17; in comparisons, of anything sweet, esp. of eloquence, Il.1.249, cf. Pi.O.10 .98; Ar.Fr.581; Mosch.2.3; Alex.146.6: prov. of those who refuse to take 'the rough with the smooth', Sapph.113

μελία.definition: Ep. manna ash, Fraxinus Ornus; ashen spear, Il.19.390, 22.225, etc

μέλισμα.definition: song, Theoc.14.31, 20.28; air, melody, AP7.196 ; lyric poetry, ib.4.1.35

μέλισσα.definition: Att. (perh. by haplology for; the term was applied

μέλκα.definition: cooling food made from sour milk, = Gal.10.468; prob. for in Alex. Trall.7.3: Gp.18.21.1

μέλος.definition: limb, in early writers always in pl; metaph., . . Ep.Rom.12.5, cf. 1 Ep.Cor.6.15

μέλοψ.definition: in form melops, = dulcis sonus, bonus cantor, Gloss

μεμόριον.definition: memorial chapel or shrine, BCH17.290, Ramsay Cities and Bishoprics 2.736

μέμψις.definition: blame, censure; ground of complaint, A.Pr.445, cf. S.Ph.1309

μένος.definition: of animals, strength, fierceness, 17.20; of horses, spirit, ib.456, 476, etc.; A.Th.393; of dogs, X.Cyn.6.15
